canonical.question: What order-update authorization rule and extra-ticket ordering instruction does the Eventbrite order-information guidance give?
canonical.expected_primary: You can only update order information if you were the original purchaser and the event organizer allows changes.
canonical.expected_secondary: If you need to add more tickets, place a separate order.
canonical.tampered_primary: Any attendee may update order information without organizer approval.
